title: Round 11 / ECDLP-38: new technique toward conjecture C* (tight x-only interpolation degree)
question: Find a proof technique beyond translation-annihilator zero counting (method barrier L2) to show that the minimal degree of g with g(x(kP)) = k on 1 <= k <= N is >= alpha*N with alpha > 1/3, e.g. via Newton divided differences on the nodes x(kP), resultants with division polynomials, or a dimension count of Riemann–Roch spaces with prescribed values; or prove that no such improvement holds in general.
success_criteria: Exact statements; pre-registered tests; reproducible evidence; honest negatives.
resource_limit: One bounded subagent; no recursion; ≤ 10 web lookups; computations < 5 min; no commits; ~75 min.
